visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with cinematic CGI scenes from a horror-themed game; a girl in a sailor uniform crawls on a wet, dark street under dim moonlight. White captions appear over the imagery. (2) Cut to a brightly lit modern indoor room where a toddler girl in patterned pajamas holds a clear glass; she looks around with a curious expression. (3) Transition to a woman with long light-brown hair wearing a beige t-shirt and shorts. She is in a clean, white-walled home setting, spreading out dark blue fabric on a floor, then sitting at a white sewing machine, carefully feeding the blue fabric through the needle. (4) Scene shifts to a large, brightly lit convention hall with blue carpets and various tech booths. The woman stands next to a tall, white and black industrial machine (TTRI AI recycling box), gesturing toward its screen while talking to a man in a light grey shirt. (5) Close-up shots of the machine's conveyor belt where pieces of red and blue clothing are being placed and scanned. (6) The woman is back at her home studio, using scissors to trim a blue sailor uniform on a child-sized dress form. She is then seen in the convention hall again, painting a grey PVC pipe with red paint at a craft table. (7) Final reveal in a dark studio set filled with red Lycoris flowers and jagged rocks. The little girl, now dressed in the completed, tattered sailor uniform, holds the painted pipe and looks at the camera with a somber, character-appropriate expression under high-contrast spotlighting.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 child, 1 male staff at the expo, and approximately 9 other attendees visible in the background at the convention hall.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main woman has light brown hair, wearing a casual beige t-shirt and light shorts. The child wears a blue and white school-style sailor uniform (cosplay) in the latter half.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Alternates between a clean, minimalist white-walled home interior, a large technological trade show with blue carpeting and display banners, and a dark, stylized photography studio set with artificial rocks and red flowers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-frequency, atmospheric drone and synthesized wind, creating an eery horror-style soundscape. A female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a calm, narrative tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the change to a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track. The female voice becomes more energetic and fast-paced. (3) Mechanical whirring and rhythmic clicks of a sewing machine are layered over the music. (4) Background ambient noise shifts to a subtle crowd murmur from the convention hall. A 'ding' sound effect highlights a text pop-up. (5) As the toddler is revealed, the music takes a dramatic, haunting turn with a female choral vocal in Japanese and high-register string arrangements. The toddler's voice is heard briefly with a soft, breathy Japanese utterance. (6) The video ends with a high-pitched digital chime associated with a social media call-to-action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution (Tech) -> Process -> Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the Taiwan Innotech Expo, specifically highlighting sustainable AI fabric recycling technology. It utilizes a personal narrative of a 'Coser Mom' creating a costume for her daughter to demonstrate the importance of textile reuse and invites viewers to the exhibition.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the exhibition name, presentation of specific technological solutions from TTRI, and a call to action for viewers to visit the event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends high-production value cosplay cinematography with lifestyle vlogging and technological promotion. The transition between horror aesthetics and bright, educational content creates a strong hook.
